disease_hierarchy_method: Eligible child evidence belongs to the selected general category. Parent-direct estimates are preferred within each overlapping study/population; otherwise one adjusted/primary child estimate is selected. Disjoint populations require explicit documentation.

headline.funnel_interpretation: Egger’s test is generally not recommended when fewer than 10 studies are available.
headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 2 studies yielded an effect size of 0.94 (95% CI: 0.83–1.06), indicating no statistically significant association between choline and kidney and renal pelvis cancer. Although the point estimate suggests a potential inverse relationship, the confidence interval includes the null. These findings were accompanied by low heterogeneity (I² = 0.00%), indicating consistent findings across the included studies.
